kjv: as that the day of Christ is at hand
mine: to the effect that the day of the Lord has come
note: enesteken is perfect, "has come / is present" (the Thessalonians thought it had already arrived); "is at hand" says the opposite of the error Paul is correcting. TR also reads "Christ" for "Lord".

kjv: that man of sin be revealed
mine: the man of lawlessness is revealed
note: TR "hamartias" against "anomias" (Sinaiticus, B), which fits "mystery of lawlessness" (2:7) and "the lawless one" (2:8).

kjv: only he who now letteth [will let]
mine: Only he who now restrains it
note: Let in 1611 meant "hinder" (as in "without let"); a modern reader takes it to mean "allow", the reverse.

kjv: God hath from the beginning chosen you
mine: God chose you as the firstfruits
note: TR "ap' arches" against "aparchen" (B, F, G, 33); the readings differ by one letter division, and the manuscripts are divided.
